author: Chris Titus Tech
description:
Zed Editor isn't just a VS Code replacement — it's what you get when Neovim and VS Code have a baby. I've been using it heavily and my setup is completely different from what you'll find anywhere else online.

In this video I cover custom tasks, Vim bindings that actually feel good, parallel agents, my image/screenshot workflow for markdown, Git integration, theme switching, and how I manage multiple open source projects seamlessly.
If you're a Neovim or VS Code user, Zed might replace both. Here's my honest take after daily use.
